exposure: stage of prolapse using International Continence Society (ICS) definitions
individual pelvic organ prolapse quantification points
cohort: 125 women who underwent robotic-assisted sacrocolpopexy and completed a standardized 1-year follow-up from 2009-2014
finding: Increasing stage of prolapse preoperatively increased the risk of recurrence at 1 year after sacrocolpopexy.
